description: This file defines the ValidateResponseChecksumParser class which decorates an existing parser to add checksum validation logic for AWS S3 responses, specifically for validating response checksums to ensure data integrity.

classes.name: ValidateResponseChecksumParser
classes.description: A decorator parser for AWS S3 that adds validation of response checksums to enhance data integrity verification.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the parser with a delegate parser and the associated S3 service API object.

methods.name: __invoke
methods.description: Invokes the wrapped parser and performs checksum validation if applicable, throwing an exception if checksum validation fails.

methods.name: parseMemberFromStream
methods.description: Delegates parsing a member from a stream to the wrapped parser.

methods.name: validateChecksum
methods.description: Performs checksum validation for the response using available algorithms and returns the validation result.

methods.name: chooseChecksumHeaderToValidate
methods.description: Selects which checksum header to validate from the response based on a priority list.
